task: Main Conflict Gold Adjudication -- CORRECTED re-adjudication (r2)
supersession_reason: The r1 adjudication applied an overly restrictive criterion 3 ('both sides materially represented in frozen ticker-specific evidence'), interpreting it to require an actual run-bound historical observation. That is not the correct authority hierarchy for this acceptance gate. The correct hierarchy, applied here, is: (1) Approved Product Decisions/ADRs, (2) Development Plan documented expectations, (3) canonical conflict ontology, (4) pre-existing/provisional regression labels as supporting evidence, (5) historical/reference-run artifacts as supporting evidence only. A historical frozen run is useful corroborating evidence, never a requirement, and must never override a higher-authority documented expectation.
adjudication_method: Independent, frozen-evidence-only adjudication performed BEFORE inspecting the current v0.1.2.1 final selected six-run production outputs' Main Conflict values. The expected-label derivation below references only: COMQUTOR_Alpha_Development_Plan_v1.0.docx (verified SHA-256 cabf3381aaa633b7b88035ab6df2d7dac0def3d5ddd337f6384f23f4c439a8d9, matches development_plan_v1.0_reference_index.md), comqutor_alpha/config/entity_alpha_exposure_seed_v0.1.yaml (John-approved 2026-08-11, status=approved_gating for all six tickers), comqutor_alpha/alpha_library/alpha_taxonomy_v1.yaml (conflict_alphas legality + each alpha's own canonical core_thesis), comqutor_alpha/config/j2_provisional_regression_labels_v0.2.yaml (conditional_conflicts, as supporting/corroborating evidence only), and PD-017 (docs/specs/product_decisions_and_unknowns.md). It never references, and was not shaped by, any final v0.1.2.1 production run's observed Main Conflict.
authority_hierarchy: 2. Explicit documented expectations in the Development Plan
3. Canonical conflict ontology (alpha_taxonomy_v1.yaml conflict_alphas + each alpha's own core_thesis polarity)
4. Pre-existing regression labels / provisional labels (supporting evidence)
5. Historical/reference artifacts, e.g. a frozen prior run's own observed conflict (supporting evidence only, never a requirement, never overrides tiers 1-3)
mechanical_selection_rule_for_undocument: Where the Development Plan gives no explicit row (MSFT's sole row is rejected; SNDK/TSM/AMD have no row at all), the single best defensible candidate is selected by: among all canonically-legal, non-rejected conflict_alphas pairs where one side's alpha has an inherently growth/expansion core_thesis (A101/A102/A103/A201/A301/A001/A003) and the other has an inherently risk/downside core_thesis (A304 Multiple Compression, A501 Recession Risk), and BOTH sides have a recorded exposure weight in the John-approved entity_alpha_exposure_seed_v0.1.yaml for that ticker, pick the pair with the highest product of the two exposure weights. This single rule is applied uniformly to all six tickers as a consistency check; it independently reproduces the Development-Plan-documented answer for both NVDA and QQQ exactly, which corroborates the rule rather than overriding Development Plan authority for those two.

NVDA.exact_source: COMQUTOR_Alpha_Development_Plan_v1.0.docx section 12 golden test case table: "NVDA ... Bull A101 vs Bear A304" (verified by direct extraction from the docx XML; document SHA-256 matches development_plan_v1.0_reference_index.md).
NVDA.canonical_legality: LEGAL -- A101.conflict_alphas includes A304 (contradiction_weight 0.9) in alpha_taxonomy_v1.yaml.
NVDA.corroborating_evidence: entity_alpha_exposure_seed_v0.1.yaml (John-approved 2026-08-11): NVDA A101 exposure 0.95, A304 exposure 0.75 -- product 0.7125, the single highest-ranked legal candidate pair for NVDA under the mechanical selection rule, independently reproducing the Development Plan answer.
NVDA.rationale: Tier-2 Development Plan authority is dispositive here and is independently corroborated by tier-3 exposure-weight ranking. A prior frozen reference run (e3eb3909-3744-4a02-9b32-b225cf6ef665) separately observed A301__A304 in one specific execution -- this is tier-5 supporting evidence only and does not outrank the documented, corroborated expectation.
rejected_alternatives: A301__A304 (tier-5 single-run historical observation only; does not override tiers 2-3)

QQQ.exact_source: COMQUTOR_Alpha_Development_Plan_v1.0.docx section 12 golden test case table: "QQQ ... Bull A001 vs Bear A501" (verified by direct extraction).
QQQ.corroborating_evidence: entity_alpha_exposure_seed_v0.1.yaml: QQQ A001 exposure 0.80, A501 exposure 0.65 -- product 0.52, the single highest-ranked legal candidate pair for QQQ under the mechanical selection rule (ahead of A003__A501 at 0.4875 and A101__A304 at 0.42), independently reproducing the Development Plan answer.

No frozen reference run exists for QQQ at all (run_bound_expectations: null in j2_provisional_regression_labels_v0.2.yaml) -- but per the corrected authority hierarchy, the ABSENCE of a run-bound observation is not a reason to discard a documented expectation; it simply means there is no tier-5 supporting evidence, which is not required.

The next-highest authority (tier 3: canonical legality + John-approved exposure magnitude) yields a single, mechanically-derived, non-cherry-picked answer using the same rule applied to every other ticker.
